desc:
🏍️ RIDE REAL E-BIKES & E-SCOOTERS. PULL WHEELIES. ESCAPE THE COPS! 🛴

Ride a Sur-Ron, Talaria, KuKirin and more through a big city: hold long wheelies to earn cash every second, deliver food for BEE EATS, fly off ramps with flips and tailwhips, and outrun the police!

✨ FEATURES
🏍️ 15+ real e-bikes & e-scooters: Light Bee X, Sting R, Ultra Bee, KuKirin G2 and more
🤸 Wheelie = $$$: the longer you hold it, the more you earn
🚨 Police chases on Easy, Medium or Hard, with roadblocks and a helicopter
🛹 Trick park and ramps: backflips, frontflips, 360s, tailwhips
🍔 BEE EATS food deliveries all over the city
🏁 Drag races every 15 minutes
🎨 Customize your ride: colours, wheels, stickers, decals, effects
📦 Crates with rare parts and effects
🤝 Gangs and rideouts with your friends
🏆 Leaderboards: top cash and longest wheelie
🌦️ Day & night, sunny days, rain and snow

🎁 CODES: RELEASE, WHEELIE, SURRON
